title: App deploy status (deploy-status.json)
description: Written by lychee-ops' lychee_admin_app and swee_app roles. swee's file also carries target_tag and installed_tag.

target_commit.description: The commit the run aimed at, or 'unknown' when it could not be read.

installed_commit.description: The last commit that passed a health check, or 'none' when nothing has.

target_tag.description: swee only: the tag the run aimed at, or 'none'.

installed_tag.description: swee only: the last tag that passed a health check, or 'none'.

_result_values.description: A comment written into the file for a human reader. Not the full enum: 'unknown' is also written.
